BYD SEAL Export Buyer Guide: Which Version Are You Actually Buying?

BYD SEAL export guide using the current UK 2026 specification as a controlled reference. Compare Design and Excellence AWD, charging, safety scope, software and destination compatibility before buying.

Use “2026” only where the source proves it

BYD UK currently markets a BYD SEAL 2026 with Design and Excellence AWD versions. This is strong evidence for the UK market; it is not proof that every SEAL offered from China or another country is the same 2026 specification.

For export purchasing, start with VIN, build date, original market and exact trim. Keep the current UK specification as a comparison reference, not a global specification sheet.

The two UK reference versions have materially different performance

BYD UK lists the Design with 354 miles WLTP combined range, rear-wheel drive and 0–62 mph in 5.9 seconds. Excellence AWD is listed with 323 miles WLTP, all-wheel drive, 0–62 mph in 3.8 seconds and 390 kW/530 PS.

The current UK leaflet identifies the Blade Battery as LFP and lists 82.5 kWh for both reference versions. A buyer should not combine the Design range with the Excellence performance and present that as one vehicle.

Charging and luggage figures must stay attached to the reference market

BYD UK states AC charging at 11 kW and DC fast charging up to 150 kW, with charging-time claims made under specified conditions. The current UK material also presents a 485 L rear boot and 72 L front boot.

Charging speed varies with charger voltage/power, battery temperature and state of charge. Before export, verify the actual charging inlet, onboard charger and software of the VIN, as another market may use a different configuration or service environment.

Safety ratings have their own scope

Euro NCAP assessed the BYD SEAL in 2023, and ANCAP states that its rating applies to BYD SEAL variants within the technical-report scope for Australia/New Zealand. Those independent assessments are useful evidence, but the buyer should record the rating year and applicable variants instead of simply writing “five-star globally. ”

For the exact export vehicle, verify airbag/ADAS specification, production period and whether the independent rating applies to that version.

Connected features can become an export problem

The UK leaflet notes that navigation is not available in all languages or countries and tells customers to check local availability. That warning is directly relevant to parallel exports. App services, OTA updates, embedded connectivity, voice control, navigation and online accounts can depend on region.

Before payment, test or obtain written evidence for the destination language, smartphone integration, app registration, OTA pathway, charging-map dependence and any subscription that matters to the customer.

Buyer decision

The SEAL can be a strong electric-saloon option, but the purchase should be tied to a specific version. Before payment verify VIN, original market, battery and motor configuration, charging inlet/power, WLTP claim source, safety-rating scope, warranty region, software/services, tyre specification, parts and diagnostic support.

Do not publish a single “global 2026 BYD SEAL specification. ” The safe approach is to show a clearly labelled market reference and then verify the offered vehicle against it.

What the quotation and contract should identify

A strong SEAL quotation should identify the VIN or, before VIN allocation, a frozen market-specific configuration that will later be reconciled to the VIN. Record original market, production date, trim, driven wheels, battery, official range test cycle, AC and DC charging hardware, wheel and tyre package and the equipment that materially affects the buyer’s decision. If the seller is quoting the UK MY26 reference, the contract should not quietly combine Design and Excellence AWD values: the Design reference carries the longer WLTP range and RWD performance figures, while Excellence AWD carries the quicker acceleration and AWD output. Once a specific export vehicle is allocated, photograph its VIN, labels, charge inlet, wheels, dashboard and key option areas and compare them against the contractual configuration.

The after-sales file matters as much as the specification sheet. Confirm which warranty region applies, whether the destination has authorised or competent high-voltage diagnosis, what charging cable is supplied and whether navigation, app functions, cellular services and OTA support are available in that market. Safety evidence should identify the exact Euro NCAP or ANCAP assessment scope being referenced rather than displaying a generic “five-star” badge. For a parallel import, connected functions may depend on region, account, SIM/network or software support. These items should be treated as conditional until written destination evidence exists. A buyer who needs fleet uptime should also identify collision parts, windscreen/ADAS calibration, tyres and battery/inverter service routes before shipment.

When the BYD SEAL evidence is not strong enough

Do not approve payment when the quotation mixes data from different trims or countries. A common error is to pair the UK Design range number with the Excellence AWD acceleration or power figure and present the result as one vehicle. Another is to treat “2026” in a current UK leaflet as proof that every SEAL in every source market is the same model-year configuration. The vehicle identity must come first; the reference brochure comes second.

Also pause when the seller cannot show the actual charge port or refuses to state whether the offered unit is RWD or AWD, when a safety rating is described as global, or when app, OTA and warranty coverage are promised without destination support. A model-family photograph or a public specification page can help identify what should be checked, but it does not prove the exact unit. The purchase is ready only when VIN-level evidence, market-specific specifications, safety scope and service assumptions no longer contradict one another.

Frequently asked questions

BYD SEAL: Is this a universal 2026 specification?

No. The figures shown here describe the UK MY2026 Design and Excellence AWD. A different original market or model year requires its own specification sheet.

BYD SEAL: Which identity evidence should be obtained before a deposit?

Request the VIN, build date, original market, exact trim and dated configuration sheet. The seller's documents and photographs must identify the same vehicle.

BYD SEAL: Does the cited safety result approve the import?

No. A crash-test rating and permission to register an imported vehicle are different matters. Check the rating's applicable variants and the destination's admission requirements separately.

BYD SEAL: What operating compatibility needs checking?

Check the actual charge port, local charging network, app and navigation availability, warranty territory and repair support. UK equipment does not prove that connected services will work abroad.

BYD SEAL: How should total landed cost be compared?

Compare the same vehicle specification, destination and delivery terms. Include inspection, transport, freight, insurance, applicable taxes, registration and any necessary adaptation.

按具体配置开展出口核验

BYD SEAL出口采购：你买到的到底是哪一个版本？

以BYD英国当前2026 SEAL为受控参考，核实Design与Excellence AWD、续航、充电、安全评级、软件和目的国兼容性，避免把英国版本写成全球统一配置。

“2026”只能用在来源真正证明的市场

BYD英国目前明确销售BYD SEAL 2026，并提供Design和Excellence AWD两个版本。 这个证据可以证明英国市场，却不能证明从中国或其他市场出口的SEAL全部属于同一个2026全球版本。

采购时必须从VIN、生产日期、原销售市场和具体版本开始。 英国2026资料只能作为对照基准，不能直接变成“全球配置表”。

两个英国参考版本的性能差异很大

BYD英国当前列出的Design为WLTP综合续航354英里、后驱、0–62 mph 5.9秒；Excellence AWD为323英里、四驱、3.8秒，并标注390 kW/530 PS。

当前英国规格资料显示两个参考版本都使用Blade Battery（LFP）并列出82.5 kWh。 不能把Design的续航和Excellence的性能拼在一起当成一辆车。

充电和空间数据也必须绑定英国参考版本

BYD英国当前资料列出11 kW交流充电和最高150 kW直流快充，并在特定条件下给出充电时间。 英国资料还列出后备箱485 L和前备箱72 L。

实际充电速度会受到充电桩、电压、温度和SOC影响。 出口前必须核实具体VIN的充电接口、车载充电机和软件，因为其他市场版本可能不同。

安全评级不能写成全球五星

Euro NCAP在2023年评估BYD SEAL，ANCAP也说明其评级有明确的技术报告和澳新适用范围。 这些都是有价值的独立证据，但应记录评级年份和版本边界，不能简化成“全球五星”。 对实际出口车辆还需要核对气囊、ADAS、生产日期和评级是否覆盖该版本。

联网功能是平行出口的重要风险

英国规格资料明确提醒导航并非所有语言和国家都支持。 这一点对出口车辆非常重要。 APP、OTA、车载网络、语音、导航和在线账户都可能受地区限制。 付款前应测试或取得书面证据，确认目的国语言、手机互联、APP注册、OTA更新、导航和相关订阅能否正常使用。

采购结论

BYD SEAL可以是很有竞争力的纯电轿车，但必须按具体版本购买。 付款前确认VIN、原市场、电池和电机、充电、续航数据来源、安全评级范围、质保区域、软件、轮胎、配件和诊断支持。

不要发布一份所谓“全球2026 BYD SEAL配置”。 更可靠的车型页应该明确写出参考市场，再把实际车源逐项核验。

用英国参考资料核对实际车源

若报价使用英国2026资料，合同应明确它只是受控参考。 实际车辆仍要通过VIN、生产日期、原销售市场、Design或Excellence AWD身份、电机与驱动形式、电池标签、充电口、轮胎和随车文件逐项确认，不能把Design的续航与Excellence AWD的性能组合成一辆不存在的车型。

付款前还应取得目的国对充电接口、无线通信、App、OTA、导航、质保区域和维修诊断的书面确认。 任何英国页面没有覆盖、实车又无法证明的配置，应标记为未确认，而不是借用其他市场页面补齐。

把性能数据转换成使用条件

WLTP续航和峰值快充功率适合在相同测试边界内比较，但不等于目的地全年实际表现。 买方还应结合气候、充电网络、日均里程和电价判断Design后驱与Excellence AWD的差异是否值得承担额外轮胎、能耗和维修复杂度。 最终付款条件应绑定同一VIN、原销售市场和配置代码，任何一项变化都要重新核对准入、充电与售后证据。

常见问题

BYD SEAL: 这是全球统一的 2026 年规格吗？

不是。本页参数只对应英国市场 2026 年款 Design 与 Excellence AWD。原销售市场或年款不同，应另行核对相应配置表。

BYD SEAL: 支付定金前需要哪些身份材料？

应取得车辆识别代号、生产日期、原销售市场、具体版本和带日期的配置表。卖方文件与照片必须指向同一辆车。

BYD SEAL: 安全评分是否等于允许进口？

不等于。碰撞安全评级与进口车辆能否登记是两件事，应分别核对评级覆盖的版本及目的国准入要求。

BYD SEAL: 需要核查哪些运行兼容条件？

应检查实车充电接口、当地充电网络、应用与导航可用性、质保区域和维修支持。英国配置不能证明联网功能在境外仍可使用。

BYD SEAL: 如何比较总到岸成本？

应统一车型配置、目的地和交付条款，再计入检验、运输、海运、保险、适用税费、登记和必要改装费用。
